automated_tests.scope: maintained application code, CCRF source, retrieval-integrity and distribution tests

checks.name: Completed query, unique inventory and processed corpus reconcile exactly
Fresh complete retrieval has a shared snapshot identity and two recorded timestamps
Analytics does not fetch an independent fresh disease-query total
Unresolved topics remain in the processed denominator
Missing year, journal and abstract fields retain valid PMIDs
Year, journal and study-type counts reconcile with the full denominator
Overlapping topic-query counts are independent of the unique corpus size
Independent topic-query timestamps remain separate from corpus provenance
Enrichment-only saves do not advance successful corpus timestamps
Different retrieval operations display both counts and their original timestamps
Mixed snapshots show the difference without a false completeness or missing-publication claim
Equal counts alone cannot prove a common retrieval
A claimed same-snapshot mismatch remains incomplete across repeated rendering
Failed refresh preserves the last complete corpus and original successful timestamp
Failed refresh retains the last successful Analytics cache without overwriting it
Subsequent enrichment saves cannot clear a failed-refresh flag
Missing ESummary citations fail retrieval and never commit partial records
A failed newer inventory and an older corpus keep distinct count provenance
An omitted EFetch record is distinguished from a present citation with no abstract
A same-count but wrong-PMID processed corpus is rejected
Duplicate processed PMIDs are explicitly rejected
Later complete retrieval restores synchronised status and accurate counts
The Analytics refresh control returns to its usable state after recovery
Reloaded valid statistics are labelled cached while preserving successful timestamps
Independent topic-query failures do not invalidate a complete corpus
Concurrent refresh requests await one completed inventory
Analytics presents query and processed denominators separately from Browse Papers

analytics_snapshot_regression.scope: Synthetic responses only; exact inventory reconciliation, unknown metadata, overlapping topics, legacy/mixed caches, failures, concurrency and recovery.

optional_real_pubmed_smoke.query: (lipedema[Title/Abstract] OR lipoedema[Title/Abstract] OR "Lipedema"[Mesh] OR lipedemas[Title/Abstract] OR lipoedemas[Title/Abstract] OR lipolymphedema[Title/Abstract] OR lipolymphedemas[Title/Abstract] OR "lipohyperplasia dolorosa"[Title/Abstract])
optional_real_pubmed_smoke.notice: Real PubMed responses; no expected publication count was hardcoded. This is not a validation of classification accuracy.
